description: The plot illustrates the results of "Whisper fine-tunning, type = small," comparing four different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale ranging from 25.0 to 42.5, with tick marks at intervals of 2.5. The plot contains four lines, all colored orange. The line representing "small AdaLoRA_int4" is a solid line with circle markers; it shows a steady decline from a starting value of approximately 35.6 at epoch 0 to an ending value of 30.5 at epoch 6. The "small AdaLoRA_int8" line is a solid line with square markers, which also steadily decreases from roughly 30.1 at epoch 0 to 25.1 at epoch 6. The "small int4" line is a dashed line with circle markers; it begins at approximately 35.6 at epoch 0, rises to a peak of 42.1 at epoch 2, and then declines to end at 31.5 at epoch 6. Finally, the "small int8" line is a dashed line with square markers, starting at roughly 30.1 at epoch 0, increasing to a peak of 33.7 at epoch 2, declining to 25.4 at epoch 5, and slightly rising to end at 25.9 at epoch 6.
